text: Treat every completion as a return home. The end of the working day, a closed door, autumn leaf fall, an exhalation before sleep, or even saying goodbye to what has outlived its time—we often perceive completion as loss. But in the great rhythm of life, any completion is a return to the source, where strength gathers for a new cycle. Try to see off every sunset and every completed stage not with regret, but as a return to the source.
